items.description: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) extended their buying streak for the third consecutive session on July 30, purchasing Indian equities worth ₹3,623 crore, signalling sustained confidence in domestic markets. In contrast, domestic institutional investors (DIIs) snapped their five-session buying streak, turning net sellers as they offloaded equities worth ₹1,864 crore.
